requirement: Every Tracy mail ends Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai, the whitelist mails carry the Did not request this? box, the site invitation drops Manage notifications, and a signed-out /?settings=notifications keeps its destination through /login

oracle.ref: PR #973 (fix); fix evidence: Spec tracy-marketing/content/email/transactional/tracy-access/spec-2026-10-06 (Sarah, 06/10/2026): the whitelist mail landed in Gmail Promotions; on cowork.tracy.site a signed-out click on Manage notifications ended on the site with Settings closed. mail-footer-terms.test.mjs is 0/7 on origin/develop c0f766e94.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. The sign-in mail's footer reads 'Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai' with links to https://tracy.ai/terms and https://tracy.ai/privacy, tracy.ai itself unlinked, and its text part ends 'Terms: https://tracy.ai/terms · Privacy: https://tracy.ai/privacy'; in Vietnamese the footer reads 'Điều khoản · Quyền riêng tư · tracy.ai'. A notification letter's footer reads 'Manage notifications · Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai', translated in the reader's language with no {{marker}} left. The whitelist invitation's subject is 'About your Tracy sign-in' and both of its variants carry the 'Did not request this? You can safely ignore this email.' box after the JoomlArt member box, in HTML and in the text part. The whitelist confirmation ends with the same box and no longer says "Didn't ask to join?". A signed-out GET /?settings=notifications redirects to /login?next=%2F%3Fsettings%3Dnotifications, also where a guest landing exists; / stays /login and /?utm_source=joomlart stays /login?utm_source=joomlart; all four /login forms carry that next.
